steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Concentrate the wastewater sample to obtain a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the wastewater sample.
Aliquot 40 mL into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 12000 RPM for 90 min.
Decant the supernatant (assume 280 µl pellet remains).

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lyse the sample pellet using Buffer AVL and vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 1120 µl prepared Buffer AVL into the Falcon tube containing the sample.
Pulse-vortex samples for 15s every 2 minutes for a total of 8 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Add ethanol and centrifuge to separate the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 1120 µl ethanol to the tube.
Centrifuge at 4000 RPM for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Process the supernatant through a QiAmp Mini column.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 µl of supernatant to the QiAmp Mini column.
Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min.
Remove flow-through and repeat the process until all supernatant has been processed.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the QiAmp Mini column.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AW1 to the column.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Replace the collection tube with a clean 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Perform the second wash of the QiAmp Mini column.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AW2 to the column.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
Replace the collection tube with a clean 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Dry the Membrane
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol by centrifuging the column.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13000 rpm for 3 min.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the column into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAamp Mini column in a clean 1.5 ml eppendorf tube.
Add 60 µl Buffer AVE equilibrated to room temperature.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g (8000 rpm) for 1 min.
